content: Container tags may be repointed, while an OCI image digest identifies immutable content. Promote and deploy a verified digest across preview/staging/production, record it in the work item/run log, and roll back by redeploying a prior digest rather than rebuilding an old source revision. Sources: https://docs.docker.com/build/policies/validate-images/ and https://docs.docker.com/learn/content/prove-where-your-image-came-from/
